records.title: feat(lsp): capability-negotiated workspace configuration pull
records.release_claim: clients that support workspace configuration get bounded, epoch-safe, root-scoped settings with honest pending and failure states
records.reason: Configuration authority cannot depend on client name or stale unbound responses; root switches must re-pull rather than reuse another root's values.
records.non_claim: Initialization-only and push fallbacks remain valid for clients without the capability.

records.title: feat(lsp): redacted setTrace and logTrace protocol tracing
records.release_claim: standard LSP trace control emits bounded structural metadata without source, URI, config, command, or packet contents
records.reason: Valuable diagnostics but independently deferrable if the selected release makes no tracing claim and retains correct client-side trace behavior.
records.non_claim: Tracing never enters analysis identity, snapshots, actions, or evidence and cannot be treated as proof.

records.title: feat(lsp): negotiate code-lens refresh with a semantic lens-view identity
records.release_claim: supported clients refresh code lenses only when their semantic view changes and clear stale lenses when analysis authority disappears
records.reason: A root or snapshot transition can otherwise leave stale repair summaries visible after diagnostics/actions have cleared.
records.non_claim: Code-lens refresh does not trigger analysis and is omitted for clients without the negotiated capability.
